rationale.methodNote: Market-blind: independent offence (xOS) and defence (xDS) ratings in goal units, seeded from pre-tournament Elo priors and updated sequentially over group-stage FIFA xG (rate 0.15) against each opponent's opposing rating. Fixture goal rates lambda = xOS_A - xDS_B + base and mu = xOS_B - xDS_A + base feed an independent-Poisson score matrix; 1X2 read off and normalised. No betting or prediction-market data was used.
